description: Get the running Vimshottari mahadasha, antardasha (bhukti) and pratyantardasha with their dates, the next ones, and the antardasha sequence. Uses a saved chart from the signed-in user's AstroLogics account or given birth details, with the chart features of the user's plan.

chart.description: A saved chart's id or name from list_my_charts. Or give the birth details below instead.

date.description: Birth date, YYYY-MM-DD (when not using a saved chart).

language.description: Set to "hi" to add Hindi (Devanagari) names next to the English ones, for answering in Hindi.

latitude.description: Birth latitude in decimal degrees (when not using a saved chart).

longitude.description: Birth longitude in decimal degrees (when not using a saved chart).

time.description: Local birth time, HH:MM (when not using a saved chart).

name: get_antardasha
title: Antardasha and pratyantardasha periods
